display.purpose: Page titles with a short measure.

components.name: Documentation Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase navigation for durable documentation destinations.
components.html: SpecificationRFCsProject
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; background: var(--asc-surface, #fffef9); border-block: 1px solid var(--asc-rule, rgba(16,23,42,.22)); padding: .8rem 1rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--asc-ink, #10172a); font-family: var(--asc-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .015em; opacity: .66; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--asc-blue, #1637f2); opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--asc-focus, #7c4a00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Document Link
components.description: Inline link treatment for references within documentation prose.
components.css: .ds-doc-link { color: var(--asc-blue, #1637f2); font-family: var(--asc-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: .08em; text-underline-offset: .18em; } .ds-doc-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: .14em; } .ds-doc-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--asc-focus, #7c4a00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Registry Table
components.description: Dense ruled table for normative registry and field data.
components.css: .ds-table { border: 1px solid var(--asc-rule, rgba(16,23,42,.22)); border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--asc-ink, #10172a); font-family: var(--asc-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif); font-size: .76rem; width: 100%; } .ds-table th { background: var(--asc-ink, #10172a); color: var(--asc-paper, #f4f2ea); font-family: var(--asc-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .035em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table td, .ds-table th { border: 1px solid var(--asc-rule, rgba(16,23,42,.22)); padding: .7rem .8rem; } .ds-table code { font-family: var(--asc-code, 'Source Code Pro', monospace); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Square, ruled container for protocol payloads and examples.
components.css: .ds-code { background: var(--md-code-bg-color, #e9e7df); border: 1px solid var(--asc-rule, rgba(16,23,42,.22)); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; color: var(--md-code-fg-color, #111827); font-family: var(--asc-code, 'Source Code Pro', monospace); font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 1rem; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--asc-focus, #7c4a00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Flat ruled container for documentation notes and disclosures.
components.html:
Note

Examples are informative unless explicitly labelled normative.
components.css: .ds-notice { background: var(--asc-surface, #fffef9); border: 1px solid var(--asc-rule, rgba(16,23,42,.22)); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; color: var(--asc-ink, #10172a); font-family: var(--asc-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif); font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.7; padding: 1rem; } .ds-notice strong { font-family: var(--asc-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-notice p { margin: .7rem 0 0; } .ds-notice:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--asc-focus, #7c4a00); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The system uses the visual grammar of public infrastructure: paper-like fields, dark ink, one-pixel rules, compressed signage type, and colour assigned to routes and state. It is direct and functional. The interface stays flat, with hierarchy carried by typography, rules, fields, and alignment.

Protocol pages are restrained reading surfaces. Their navigation, tables, code, and notices use the same wayfinding language without reproducing the homepage's expressive composition. Light and dark themes preserve roles rather than fixed appearances.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper and ink surfaces with visible structural rules.
Condensed headings and labels paired with hyperlegible body text.
Semantic colour used for navigation and status distinctions.
Square containers, explicit focus, and responsive reading layouts.

rules.name: The Route Colour Rule
rules.body: Assign signal colours to protocol meaning, navigation, or state. Do not scatter them through ordinary prose as decoration.

rules.name: The Role-Preserving Theme Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes the values of semantic roles. It does not change which roles a component uses.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use condensed type for orientation, hyperlegible type for explanation, and monospace for machine-readable values.

rules.name: The Flat Infrastructure Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields, rules, and alignment for depth. Do not introduce elevation as decoration.

rules.name: The Square Field Rule
rules.body: Keep documentation containers square. Do not turn content groups into rounded card grids.

dos: Do keep normative pages calm, scannable, and within the established reading measure.
Do use the three type families according to orientation, explanation, and machine-readable content.
Do preserve semantic colour roles across light and dark themes.
Do expose keyboard focus and horizontal table overflow.
Do keep ASC 0.1 visibly experimental where maturity is stated.
donts: Don't infer protocol meaning from colour alone.
Don't use route colours as incidental prose decoration.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glass effects, or rounded card grids.
Don't apply homepage-specific interchange or class-band composition to protocol pages.
Don't trade reading order or printable structure for visual expression.
